lines.text: Ben has climbed 23 of New Hampshire's 48 four-thousand-footers.
Ask him which ones, and he scrolls through four years of blurry summit photos.
Dates, routes, who was there, all gone.
So his sister printed him a logbook.
One board to color in, one card for every peak: route, times, weather, who came along.
Last weekend he filled in number 24 at the trailhead.
Save this for the peak bagger on your gift list.
